Class CSVFormatter

java.lang.Object
gate.lang.csv.CSVFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class CSVFormatter extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Appends lists and arrays of strings, as CSV formatted rows, into an Writer.

Each string list or array will be written as a CSV row having each column double quoted and separated by commas
